name: SAML assertion not signed
description:
A SAMLResponse sent to the application carries an Assertion with no XML signature, neither on the Assertion nor on the enclosing Response. A service provider that accepts such an assertion lets anyone who can post to its assertion consumer service log in as any user by writing the NameID and attributes they want.

burpsy reports this passively from the observed SAMLResponse, so it is tentative: confirm by replaying the response with an altered NameID and checking whether the login succeeds.

This row is burpsy's own: Burp's issue catalogue has no entry for it.
remediation: Configure the identity provider to sign assertions, and configure the service provider to require a valid signature, from the identity provider's pinned certificate, on every assertion it accepts. Reject unsigned and wrongly signed responses before reading any attribute.

vulnerabilityClassifications.title: CWE-347: Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature
